facts.fact: Ghana News Agency reports Data Protection Commission head Dr Arnold Kavaarpuo saying Ghana was introducing a new bill to regulate AI, automated decision-making and cross-border data transfers.

GHA.note: Nothing on government use of AI.

facts.fact: Ghana News Agency reports the Data Protection Commission's bill, covering AI, automated decision-making and cross-border transfers, was set to be presented to Parliament, per committee chairman Abednego Bandim Azumah and Commissioner Dr Arnold Kavaarpuo.

GHA.note: Nothing on AI in a sector's public system.
Nothing on AI built or hosted in the country.

facts.fact: Ghana News Agency quotes Dr Arnold Kavaarpuo as Executive Director and Commissioner of Ghana's Data Protection Commission, which was acting on emerging AI and deepfake challenges.

Committee chairman Abednego Bandim Azumah is quoted by Ghana News Agency saying the current Data Protection Act (Act 843) of 2012 needs revision; a Data Protection Commission bill to strengthen it was set to go to Parliament.
